source_prompt: Surreal fantasy painting of the Roman Colosseum standing in a green field under a swirling cosmic night sky with stars and nebulae. Four beautiful women with blue, purple, and dark hair emerge from clouds in the upper portion, symmetrically arranged around a glowing green and blue geometric mandala.
